svg.title: Skill 11 - Bisect
svg.desc: Animation: eight commits, the tip is bad and the base is good; git bisect checks out the middle commit, each good or bad answer halves the suspects, and after three tests the first bad commit is found.

g.text: babc8b9 is the first bad commit
A bug slipped into one of the last 8 commits. Which one?
Mark the tip bad and an older commit good. Git checks out the middle…
…you test it and answer good or bad. Every answer halves the suspects.
Three answers later: the first bad commit — despite its innocent message.
Scales like magic: 1,000 commits ≈ 10 tests. End with git bisect reset .
